# Recursive agents with Katara Cortex and x402

> Bounded research agents using Katara Cortex and native USDC through x402 on Avalanche C-Chain. Begin with offline verification.

## Start

- [README](README.md): setup, five examples and evidence.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): standalone operating rules; CLAUDE.md is an identical mirror.
- [Contributor guide](docs/contributing.html): module map, extension recipes and JSON CLI.
- [API reference](docs/api.html): generated JSDoc contracts.
- [Full text](llms-full.txt): generated guidance and API text.

## Data and behavior

- [Scenario schema](schemas/v1/scenario.schema.json): source scopes and task trees.
- [Run report schema](schemas/v1/run-report.schema.json): results, reviews and payments.
- [Synopsis revision schema](schemas/v1/synopsis-revision.schema.json): input and revision provenance.
- [CLI response schema](schemas/v1/cli-response.schema.json): structured output and errors.
- [Payments and evidence](docs/payments.html): signing, caps and finalized settlement.
- [Sample answers](evidence/results.html): explicitly labeled offline fixtures.

## Maintenance

- [Package commands](package.json): build, test, audit and regeneration.
- [MIT license](LICENSE): project reuse terms.
